_comment: One strip of cloth per role, keyed by chapter id (the company name, slugified; see lib/content.ts). `pattern` picks a draft from lib/kente.ts. Each strip is woven after a named kente design whose meaning suits the chapter; `name` and `meaning` are shown on the site, so check spelling and sense with someone who knows the cloth before changing them. `note` is one line on why this design fits this chapter.

truckrsoft-technologies.name: Ahwepan
truckrsoft-technologies.meaning: Plain. The simplest cloth: warp stripes and very few motifs.
truckrsoft-technologies.note: A first job. Learn the warp before you try the weft.

aces-knust.name: Abusua ye dom
aces-knust.note: Four student developers, weekly sprints, one shared site.

asqii-ltd.name: Babadua
asqii-ltd.meaning: A tough, jointed cane, used to build. Strength made of segments.
asqii-ltd.note: Software for a national regulator, delivered, deployed and taught.

jls-trading-co.name: Sika futuro
jls-trading-co.meaning: Gold dust. Wealth, and the care it takes to count it.
jls-trading-co.note: Warehouses, inventory and fuel bills: commerce, measured.

quest-systems-ltd.name: Wofro dua pa a
quest-systems-ltd.meaning: When you climb a good tree, you are given a push.
quest-systems-ltd.note: A first hospital system. The push toward healthcare.

wink-initiatives.name: Obaakofoo mmu man
wink-initiatives.meaning: One person does not rule a nation.
wink-initiatives.note: Leading four developers to match blood donors with those in need.

my-creativity-box-inc.name: Emaa da
my-creativity-box-inc.meaning: It has never happened before. Novelty; invention.
my-creativity-box-inc.note: Learning kits for curious kids, and the shops that sell them.

retain-health.name: Adweneasa
retain-health.meaning: My skill is exhausted. Every motif at once: the weaver's masterwork.
